meta.cite: Barton O. Oliver's mTOR Atlas (live data, not an archived version; give corpus_snapshot and source_commit). doi:10.5281/zenodo.22059963

data.mechanism: ULK1 phosphorylates AMPK back, damping the signal that activated it - a negative feedback loop that stops autophagy running away.
data.mechanism_beginner: ULK1 tags AMPK back and calms it down – a feedback loop that keeps cleanup from running out of control.
data.context: Closes a loop rather than acting as a one-way arrow; steady-state behaviour depends on the relative strength of both directions.
data.boundary: One study in human cells and mouse (LOF2011). A single study. The feedback loop is shown in cell models, and the relation in the other direction (AMPK-ULK1) is contested.

confidence.human_relevance_label: plausible in people, not shown directly
